notes.title: 1.6.1 version
notes.content:
Fixed internal links to redirect on spelbookgame.com
Fixed an issue where jump portal menu remained open

notes.title: The Oblivion
notes.content:
Join us on Friday February 14th at 6pm US-Central time! An entirely new experience with fast-paced progression, permanent ship loss and small corporation teams!

Login Screen -> Select Character -> Oblivion Mode -> Create Character

-= v1.5.2 - The Oblivion Server
- PvP everywhere except systems near Earth
- Corporations limited to 15 members
- Alliances limited to 2 corporations
- Items cannot be repaired
- Items cannot upgrade to Ultimate with Tech Points
- Ships lose 10% Durability on death and break at 0%
- Ships drop 1 random equipped item on death
- Hardcore ships lose 100% durability on death
- Hardcore ships drop all equipped items on death
- Captains can only follow their own ships
- No Love Day mechanics
- Accelerated loot drops, crafting skill and XP gains
- Crafters can create Legendary and Ultimate items
- No free ships or relic level-up rewards
- Tech Point orders deliver to both servers
- Reward Point Gifts can buy Ultimate Party Boxes

notes.title: Bug Fixes v1.5.1
notes.content:
- Many minor bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements
- Added Primary Citizen Count to alliances (see Wiki)
- Backend prep for major game engine update

notes.title: Leaderboards & Mega Server Merge
notes.content:
This is the largest update since the game went live! There are tons of quality-of-life improvements, new interface panels for viewing lists of items or ships, 80 leaderboards with weekly and monthly rankings, plus much more!

The largest change is that all players now join a single server instead of regional servers. Additionally, players can create multiple characters per account instead of being limited to just one!

-= v1.5.0
- All servers merged into one mega-server
- Leaderboards for players & corps (Week, Month, Life)
- Players can start new characters on their account
- New item, ship, achievement, leaderboard list panels
- Crafting: Void Kit converts non-void items to Void rarity
- Reward Points: Re-Void Kit re-rolls an item's Void bonus
- Defense units gain much larger benefits from slow weapons
- Combat slowed during large PvP events (Time dilation)
- Many improvements to network lag during large events
- Ship +Xp% Bonus grants more XP to Player and Corporation
- Hack Ram + Hacking III targets and purges repair-over-time
- WEEKEND POWER event: Bonus loot and PvP skulls plus more!
- Bug fixes related to grapple, cloak and network lag
- Adv Hacking III purges repair-over-time and hacks target
- Alliances need 7 citizens to control Security Rating 8 maps
- Defense unit protection shields last between server reboots
- Removed many annoying popups
- "Tech Points for Resources" trade gives almost 2x more bonus
- Nova Explosion and Garrison Strike hit more targets
- Battle Ram damage can splash to multiple targets

notes.title: Game Engine Overhaul II
notes.content:
Today wraps up phase 2 of a 3-part game engine overhaul, adding additional support for modern graphics hardware, shaders, post-processing, and more. We're closer than ever to our goal of a lag-free experience with 500 ships in a single battle!

We've also added several new features, like a Level 200 reward of the Vanquisher ship class!

-= v1.4.3
- Game engine update improves lag and performance
- "Battery Drain" ability renamed "Drain" and also steals shields
- Level 200+ Captains unlock Vanquisher ship class
- Player fleet's 10th ship can now be any size
- New jump gates added to Ash hub and SR9 Homeworld maps
- Security Rating 8 maps can be captured by alliances
- Planets deployed on Sacred Shrines grant bonus to entire alliance
- Grapple/Drag does not work in defense unit sectors
- Ships may not recall or log out in defense engagements
- Defense units have a recall timer (attacks cancel recall)
- Refund for defense unit recall removed
- Alliance protection shield now 7 hours instead of 4
- Gravity Drive new ability: Instant Jump chance per move
- More Gravity Drives in fleet increase chances
- Carriers with Gravity Drive instant jump the fleet
- Friendly ships with Gravity Drive trigger at same time

notes.title: Game Engine Overhaul
notes.content:
Today's major update is a total refresh of the core game engine, with huge gains in performance. Lag during large fleet events is drastically improved. This update also introduces support for modern graphics hardware, shaders, post-processing, and more.

Besides that, there's a ton of new features, daily events, item buffs and new combat mechanics such as shield regeneration!

-= v1.4.0
- Major game engine update:
 * Improvements to framerates, lag, crashing, memory
 * Added support for all modern GPUs and mobile devices
 * Less battery consumed on mobile
 * Sharper lights, shadows, post-processing
- All fast Weapon damage increased significantly
- Shields repair during combat (Wyrd ships are faster)
- Assassin-class ships gain +1 Equip Point
- Assassin-class ships cloaking cooldown 50% faster
- XP gains in Security Rating 7+ increased
- Loot from invasion victory significanty increased
- Ship durability damage removed from the game
- New daily events
- Alliances can invite over the citizen cap for a cost
- Server hardware upgraded
- New ULTIMATE Arena Mode: All equipped items upgraded!
- Hardcore Arena loot 25% chance to be VOID
- Chaos Arena 50% chance to be Ultimate Mode
- Reduced lag during large-scale fleet combat
- All CPUs visible in 'Versions' item list
- Using a CPU Upgrade Kit removes NO DROP
- Battle Ram works better for smaller ships
- Added a 4th ship list column (Settings -> Gameplay)

notes.title: Void Items & Weekly Gifts
notes.content:
This update has been in the works for months! Today we've added a new category of gear, called Void items, which are rare and powerful upgrades to normal equipment. Earn Void gear by logging in each week to claim a free gift box, then follow the mission it grants.

There are tons of other improvements and features, all suggested by players like you!

-= v1.3.7
- VOID loot is a new powerful class of items!
- Collect free weekly Party Box gifts (Player Panel)
- Discover VOID items in weekly Party Box gifts
- NPC planets respawn every Love Day
- Level 150 gets +5 Skill Point Cap (Corps, Players, Ships)
- Alien Hunter (Scavenger) gives the bonus to entire fleet
- Players & Corps max bank size now 243 items
- Item Vault max now 800
- Het Shuttles get +1 Drone Slot
- XP gains boosted everywhere and SR7+ in particular
- Arena: Victory goes to team with the most kills
- Arena: Top Killers get rewards even if they lose
- Arena: Top Repairs get rewards even if they lose
- Arena: Skull awards based on participation
- Phoenix Rebirth works for PvE, PvP and Arena
- Phoenix Rebirth cloak power 1 + Elite Rank
- Use :ARENA in chat for Arena Battle Reports
- Use :REBIRTH in chat to see Phoenix Rebirth timers
- Shield Pierce stat capped at 115%
- Unique Ship raffle prices reduced by 75%
- Bug Fix: Unique Ships display correctly after server xfer

notes.title: Gladiator & Phoenix
notes.content:
This major update introduces a ton of content, features and fun stuff to do! No matter if you're a PvP Gladiator or PvE Farmer there's something new for everyone!

First, players can now transfer ships, items and currency between servers. This allows for our EU/UK players to access the London-based Universe 2 server, or North American players to get on Universe 1. See the in-game wiki for details.

Captains can become a Gladiator climbing the ranks of Arena combat! Every 100 victories unlocks a unique title and Gladiator Ship Mod, with new Vorpal and Savior technology.

For players interested in co-op PvE they can defeat invading aliens and pirates to earn the powerful Phoenix ship mod and Rebirth technology, which saves your ships from fatal damage!

New crafting mechanics unlock Tech Computer upgrade kits, which introduces a new path to acquire the most powerful items in the game!

-= v1.3.6
- Universe server transfers unlocked
- Earn exclusive Gladiator rewards in The Arena
- Earn exclusive Phoenix rewards from Invasions
- New ship mods: Gladiator and Phoenix
- New ship tech: Vorpal, Savior, Rebirth
- Deconstruct computers to craft Tech Upgrade Kits
- AI chat personalities provide help and fun
- Corps can move members around with :CORP MOVE
- Sage Tech Computers get +1 Equip Point Bonus
- Hack Ram ability uses Hack Resist and Hack Power
- Use :PVP in chat to see World PvP Battle Report
- Use :UNIQUE in chat to see Unique Ship Leaderboard
- Holiday Event and Gem Loot significantly improved
- Invasion difficulty reduced
- Invasion Victory Loot requires 30 kills (was 50)
- Invasion timing won't interrupt The Arena
- Invasion ship collision cap now 150 (was 75)
- Party Boxes cannot be auctioned
- Players you ignore cannot follow you
- Defense units require 3,000+ Gear Score
- Hundreds of quality-of-life and bug fixes

notes.title: Party Time!
notes.content:
Today's update introduces the Party Box! These consumable items generate random group activities for corporations and alliances to do as a team. The box then gets thrown randomly into the universe for other players to find, who can then gift their own team with a party!

In other news, Invasions have a victory condition on Wave 20 with bonus loot and new Unique Ship raffles are live!

-= v1.3.5
- New Party Box events for everyone -- See wiki for details
- Invasions: Defeat 20 waves to win
- Unique Ship Raffles now live
- Battle Ram special item can STUN and THROW enemies
- Invasion Ship death durability loss reduced
- All Corporation Planet tech bonuses increased
- Corps can capture up to 4 Relic Shrines (was 1)
- Alliances can capture up to 10 Relic Shrines (was 4)
- Max Alliance Citizens now 180 (Universe #1)
- Max Alliance Corporations now 6
- Achievements for earning captain titles
- Achievements for party boxes
- Interdictor crafting uses 40 Oblivion Fragments
- Settings -> Gameplay -> Ship Buttons -> Reduce Flashing
- Many additional quality-of-life improvements

notes.title: Unique Ships & New Engines
notes.content:
Today's update introduces many player-requested features, bug fixes and new content! You can now craft the powerful Interdictor Ship Mod, granting your Carrier-Class ships a disruptive gravity effect to slow down enemies. A new technology called Hack Ram slams opponents with disruptive data when you move in or out of their sector!

One-of-a-kind unique ships will be auctioned and raffled by alien faction leaders. These enter the universe slowly at about 3 per month.

-= v1.3.4
- All ships repaired for 4% durability! (Sept 29th, 2023)
- Powerful unique ships sold by alien faction leaders!
- Interdictor Ship Mod crafted with Relics & Fragments
- New engine: Neutron Drive can disrupt grapple
- Depleted Skip Drives convert into Neutron Drives
- New tech: Hack Ram will hack enemies when you move!
- All Flagship-Class ships gain Hack Ram tech
- Deception Modules add Rank 1 Hack Ram tech
- Hacker special gains Hack Ram immunity
- Advanced Construct special gains Battle & Hack Ram immunity
- 2 new daily events
- NPC Assassin Leaders spawn more and drop more loot
- Scout special scans up to +3 sector range
- Uncaptured relic shrines can move randomly
- Interdictor won't effect friends during invasions
- Crafted ships can begin up to Level 35 (was 18)
- Defense Engagements: Attackers locked in for 99 seconds
- Defense Engagements: Planets use interdictor vs attackers
- Friended players can see through Deception module

notes.title: Daily Events & Wild Mutations!
notes.content:
Today's update adds tons of new daily PvE events to make hunting and invasions more interesting! There's a slew of additions to the invasion system and a re-design of defense unit engagements. The new Re-Mutate Item Kit allows a single re-roll of your badly mutated items! See the in-game wiki for details!

-= v1.3.2
- Sage Computers gain Scan Technology & Resource Capacity
- Re-Mutate Kits fix bad mutates! See Wiki: Mutate Item Kit
- Fixed "circular following" bug that broke movement
- Defense Engagements: All PvP blocked for 90 seconds
- Killing NPC Defense Units grants Reward Point Gifts!
- Many new daily events add spice to our lives!
- Multiple boring daily events removed
- Weird Alien Artifact cannot be used in Hardcore Arena
- Many obnoxious popups and chat spam messages removed
- Removed solo player missions to bust defense units
- Made "hunt specific ship class" missions much easier
- Corp Defenders now pull from the entire alliance
- Fixed bug causing multiple waves of Corp Defenders
- Fixed several mobile crash and network lag issues
- Improved item filter and sorting
- Invasions: Attacks hourly on schedule so you can plan ahead
- Invasions: High-level players always earn XP
- Invasions: A lot more loot drops and less difficult
- Invasions: Longer delay until PvP re-activates when complete
- Invasions: Novas and nova damage decreased

notes.title: Invasions!
notes.content:
Our first major PvE update introduces hourly Tower Defense-style Invasions across the galaxy! Jump to a garrison under attack to join other players in defense! PvP is suspended during invasions while captains battle waves of leaders, bosses and their minions!

-= 1.3.0
- Invasions are live! (See Discord for details)
- All ships repaired for 6% Durability (Aug 12 2023)
- Lag and crashing significantly improved
- High-level Captains can hunt lower-level areas without penalty
- Engagements: Corp Defenders will no longer recall early
- Engagements: Quick Jump to DEFEND will be faster & easier
- Engagements: Defenses get 90-second protection shield when attacked
- PvP killing shots grant 1 Reward Point (see in-game wiki)
- Invasions: High-level players always earn XP
- Invasions: 4x Loot Drops
- Invasions: PvP is suspended during attacks
- Invasions: Attacks hourly on schedule so you can plan ahead

notes.title: Deception, Stealth & Engagements!
notes.content:
Today's update brings sweeping changes to Defense Unit Engagements, world PvP, The Arena plus many quality-of-life improvements! We've added several new items like the Deception Module which hides equipped gear from other players while giving enemies false information.

If you've got 100+ Tech Points from us in the past type :GIFT into chat for a free bonus -- Thanks for your support!

-= v1.2.8
- Use :GIFT in chat to see your Reward Point Gifts!
- Deception Module mod hides equipped gear from everyone!
- Introduced 6 new Retro Ship Skins
- Stealth Drive: Break attacker's target locks on move
- Stealth Drive: Gives enemies incorrect info about ship
- Engagements: Offense & defense both give 2x-3x Skulls!
- Engagements: Destroyed defenses can't re-deploy for 3 hours
- Engagements: Protection shield lasts 60 minutes instead of 10
- Engagements: Defenses in protection mode deal 3x damage
- Engagements: Defenses in enemy maps don't repair
- Engagements: Max 5 Outposts deployed per day in enemy maps
- Engagements: More Corp Defenders deploy when attacked
- Engagements: AI Defenders recall as player defenders arrive
- Engagements: Collision cap for defenders & attackers is 75
- Alliances can deploy outposts in Security Rating 8 maps

notes.title: Big Update & Launch Party
notes.content:
Today's update wrapped up several major features while adding tons of fun new mechanics!

[list]
[*] Mutate your items to add unique random bonuses
[*] New mission types and bosses
[*] Hundreds of items got buffed with big stat gains
[*] Defense units gain immunity when you kill attackers
[*] Many, many more changes -- Check it out!
[/list]

[b]Are you ready for UNIVERSE 2 launch party TOMORROW?![/b]

Join us [b]Friday, June 16th at 7 PM US-CENTRAL[/b] for over 50,000 free Tech Points and Server First achievements!

notes.title: Early Access Ends & Universe #2
notes.content:
It has been a long journey but The Infinite Black 2 is now finally ready for full release. Join us on JUNE 16th at 7 PM US-CENTRAL for the launch of Universe #2!

Come with friends or forge new alliances during this unique [b]Day 1 Experience[/b] with over 50,000 free Tech Points from Server First Achievements!

[list]
[*] Transfers between Universe 1 and 2 unlock January 2024.
[*] Located in the EU/UK region for a better international experience.
[*] Jump into [url=https://discord.gg/DswgrMHWf9]Discord[/url] for more details.
[/list]

notes.title: End Game Loot & Gear Swapping
notes.content:
Huge quality-of-life update with a lot of player requests delivered, plus new end-game PvE loot from alien defenses! Quickly save and swap gear sets, purge negative effects from your friends and enjoy a bunch of new daily events that cycle every 8 hours!

Also you can upgrade the starting ship to make it into an end-game beast!

v1.2.4
- Gear Loadout quick-swap equipment sets
- New end-game loot for NPC defense unit kills
- Five new daily events
- Battery Drain ability doesn't use any battery power
- New PURGE ability removes hack & grapple instead of repair
- Better "Collision" rules when sector is too full (See Discord)
- Cap your next item craft with :CRAFTSKILL
- Inactive players don't count as Alliance Citizens (15 days)
- Bigger prizes for Chaos Arena!
- 3 daily events that cycle every 8 hours
- Harvest Resources missions much easier
- Striker Gunboat: +3 Equip Points per Elite Rank
- Striker Gunboat: +Weapon, Battery & Drone Slots with Elite Ranks
- Striker Gunboat: +Reverse Hacking at Elite Rank 4
- Striker Gunboat: +Reverse Grapple at Elite Rank 5

notes.title: Alien Bosses & Chaos Arena!
notes.content:
Due to popular demand we've continued focus on Player vs Environment content with new AI Faction Leaders! These bosses roam the universe gathering up fleets of elite allies to chase down player captains using new advanced strategic AI logic!

There are many other new features and quality-of-life improvements, plus a new Chaos Mode arena where players are thrown into a wild PvP free-for-all!

-= v1.2.3
- Chaos Arena Mode: Free-For-All three times per day!
- 75 new "Kill Leader" achievements
- AI Leaders roam the universe with big piles of loot!
- New NPC AI logic creates more realistic battles
- Captains may cancel Exploration Missions
- Arena: Minimum ship requirements reduced (See Discord)
- Arena: Ties go to the team with the most kills
- Arena: Win/Loss ranking system more forgiving
- Loot drop rates were increased
- NPCs are easier below Security Rating 8
- Harvest Resources mission requirements reduced
- Corps can cancel missions (See :CORP or :ALLIANCE in chat)

notes.title: Alien Homeworld Raids
notes.content:
Today's update delivers a space-slurry of new maps and content! Aliens and Pirates now have dedicated homeworld systems with bonus loot and mission challenges!

Small and casual corporations looking for an Alliance will find more options available -- Each alliance can have up to 8 corporations!

-= v1.2.2 =-
- Six new maps including Security Rating 9 Homeworld Raids
- Loot drops doubled in Homeworld Raid maps
- Loot drops boosted 25% in Security Rating 8 maps
- New 'Explore the Universe' rewards
- Alliances may have up to 8 corporations
- Alliances are limited to 250 Citizens - See Alliances Wiki
- Hardcore ships may travel anywhere (not just PvP maps)
- Bug Fix: Gravity Drive gets disabled when hacked
- Arena: Standard Arena squad size is 3! (Previously 2)
- Arena: Squads must average 1500+ Gear Score for full rewards
- Arena: Advanced players must bring more than 1 ship (See Discord)
- Arena: Interdictor ship mod loot drops about 1 per month
- Elite Rank Roman numerals match the Rank # (One=I, Two=II, etc)

notes.title: Missions & The Spaceball!
notes.content:
Today's update marks the delivery of promised and long-awaited features: Missions, new player objectives, dynamic Corporate Alliances and more! The classic mini-game Spaceball from the original Infinite Black also makes a triumphant return!

Returning players will enjoy several free bonus ships, faster movement speeds, tons of bug fixes and many quality-of-life improvements.

-= v1.2.1 =-
- New Missions and Objectives system
- New Corporation Alliance system
- The Spaceball has returned!
- Corps can transfer Tech Points to other corps
- Players earn free ships at Level 5, 10 and 15
- Captains can deploy up to 10 ships in their fleet
- Large fleets have ship size requirements (See Wiki)
- Skills can invest 10 points instead of 5 (15 for Hardcore)
- All ships movement speeds increased
- Emperor and Small Ship move speeds improved more
- Resource drop rates increased
- Fire damage in The Arena increased
- Cost of resetting skills reduced by 90%
- No ships are Account Bound
- 8 new Daily Events
- Many quality-of-life options in Gameplay Settings
- Wiki has search bar
- Hack disables NPC's Interdictor Carrier effect
- Hack duration is increased
- Corp Defenders won't lose durability on death
- All corp member ships are automatically Corp Defenders
- Capture Artifact uses Corp Tech Points
- Relic Shrines can only be captured by Garrisons

notes.title: Massive Fleet Battles
notes.content:
Our biggest quality-of-life update since launch! A rewrite of the main interface, faster movement, tons of new items and features all suggested by players!

-=[ v1.1.7 ]=-
- Pre-jump "animation" movement speed 2x faster
- Big fleet battle lag is fixed
- Improved all game interface buttons
- New death effects look better and fix memory leak bug

- Captains get a new 'Item Upgrade Bonus' with each upgrade!

- Cloak duration increased and battery cost decreased

- Tank special gains new Taunt ability (Ultra-Rare+)
- Technician technology protects from Taunt (See Wiki)

- Scan cooldown and battery cost decreased significantly

- Settings -> Graphics -> Low Quality Drones

notes.title: Fleet Battles & Corp Defense
notes.content:
We've listened to your feedback and made significant improvements to PvP and The Arena!

Craft the new Quality Repair Kits to fix beat-up gear or upgrade a low-level items!

-=[ v1.1.3 ]=-
- Tons of PvP and PvE improvements by player request!
- Quality Repair Kits can be crafted to upgrade gear
- New "Fleet Battle" Arena Mode
- UI improvements to listing your fleet ships
- Corporations can change to any alliance without restrictions
- Ship and Item durability damage from PvP reduced by 75%

notes.title: Intergalactic Love Day
notes.content:
We've listened to player feedback and added tons of new features! Every other day is now [b]Intergalactic Love Day[/b] where open-world PvP is not allowed. Players can use this time to work together on challenging PvE content and play without stress.

-=[ v1.1.2 ]=-
- Many bug fixes and feature requests
- Elite Rank no longer repairs ships (Use REPAIR button)
- PvE Farming Days (Intergalactic Love Day)
- Free-For-All Arena Battle Mode
- 6 new Daily Events
- Only powerful NPCs get Daily Event bonuses
- Bonus from all Marauder Technology doubled
- Emperor-Class ships are faster and have +1 EquipPoint
- Server-side hardware upgrades fixed lag issues
- All ships repaired 3% Durability on 1/7/2023 (See Discord)
- Weak alliances receive a significant PvP bonus
- Defense units refund 20 Tech Points when recalled
- NPCs can no longer drag to jump gates and defenses
- Security Rating 8 maps are NPC homeworlds and not for capture

- Crafters can queue up multiple item builds

- The starmap reveals ship counts only during fleet PvP
- Ship counts on starmap only visible when big fleets (70+)
- Carrier bonus works for entire alliance
- Crux Drive takes crew from resource bank

notes.title: The Alliance Wars
notes.content:
The Alliance Wars have begun! This is the largest update in the game's history with hundreds of new items and features based entirely on community feedback!

Players join one of three alliances to fight for control of the universe to earn powerful Relics!

Update v1.1.0

-=[ Alliance Wars ]=-
- 3 new alliance factions fight for the universe!
- All corporations are members of one Alliance
- PvP maps contain a Shrine control point
- Corps deploy defense units to capture Shrines
- Shrines generate relics for controlling Alliance
- Corps earn Alliance Points for participation
- Alliance Points can buy relics from the Alliance

- All shipyard cooldowns and queues removed
- Powerful ships use the new Relic crafting component
- Players get Relics as level-up rewards and loot
- Corporations have a Ship Craft Skill

- Rare Crafted ships can get +1 or +2 or +3 EP

- Adv. Shields and Adv. Construct add Shield Capacity
- New Special: Drone Master
- Drone Master & Weird Alien Artifact add +1 Drone Slot
- Alien Hunter & Bounty Hunter specials add +1 Weapon Slot
- Vampire & Alien Technology add +1 Battery Slot

-=[ Other Notes ]=-
- Many bugs and crashes fixed
- Major improvements to the Starmap
- Player Skills can train above 5 (with a penalty)

notes.title: Release Event - Free Steam Gifts!
notes.content:
The Infinite Black 2 is now live! We're excited to bring our indie game to the masses and have some gifts for you!

Steam players receive 7 days of +10% Xp Bonus, two custom Captain Titles ​and an exclusive Scorpion Retro Ship Skin.

[b]These are valuable items you can use, trade or sell -- Don't scrap them![/b]

Gifts are delivered once you reach Captain Level 7.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43071559/851613810b43ec1e16ba3c7a69fda31632c58a3b.png[/img]
The Shuttle-Class Retro Scorpion
